name: Arezou Khoury
education: Associate degree in Electrical Engineering Technology
bio: Arezou spends their weekdays troubleshooting rail signal cabinets and their nights bouncing between boxing breakdowns, WWE clips, and goofy comedy videos that keep the group chat alive. They cook easy vegetarian dinners in a tiny apartment kitchen, collect sour gummy candy like trophies, and still know every word to "Many Men." On some weekends they help a friend DJ community parties, then end up line dancing in work boots without ever changing shoes. They're the kind of neighbor who will show up for a safety meeting, then head home to rewatch a 90s sitcom episode before bed.
